scientific.integrity: The result reconstructs the defining MoMo Algorithm 1 directly, proves the cap is inactive under the stated hypothesis, reduces the complete deterministic scalar dynamics to a one-dimensional contraction, and solves its unique fixed point exactly.
limitations: Exact lower bound and no weight decay or preconditioning.
Constant user cap at least \(1/(2a)\), so clipping by the cap never occurs.
Original exponentially weighted MoMo variant, not bias-corrected MoMo or MoMo-Adam.
No claim that momentum is generally harmful outside this benchmark.

title: MoMo momentum has an exact scalar slowdown law
